[Luc Deveraux] Luc Deveraux is a fictional character and the protagonist of the "Universal Soldier" film series. He is most famously portrayed by Belgian actor and martial artist Jean-Claude Van Damme. Van Damme portrays Luc in the 1992 film "Universal Soldier" and its sequels "Universal Soldier" (1999), "Universal Soldier: Regeneration" (2009), and "Universal Soldier: Fall of Liberty" (2012); he is portrayed by Matt Battaglia in the direct-to-video sequels "Universal Soldier: The Return" (1998) and "Universal Soldier: Revolt" (1998).

He is also known for playing Bradley Hume in "Holby City", Lucian in "Doctor Strange", Kiley in "The Bourne Ultimatum" and John in "Zero Dark Thirty". Adkins has also appeared in "EastEnders", "Hollyoaks", "Doctors" as well as starred in many direct-to-video films.

Final answer: Jean-Claude Van Damme
